concerns.text: Tasks T004/T004a implement a substitution of 'Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench' with 'AgentBench' (lmz/agentbench) without a corresponding amendment in spec.md. This silently relaxes FR-001's explicit dataset requirement. The spec must be amended to authorize this data substitution before the task can be considered compliant.

Tasks T006 and T014 implement 'cosine similarity of sentence embeddings' as a proxy for FR-007's 'attention-weighted token overlap'. While the Plan forbids model attention, the Spec (FR-007) explicitly mandates the attention-weighted method. The tasks silently weaken the FR by adopting a proxy without a formal spec amendment or explicit 'staged' notation in the task description acknowledging the deviation from the FR's literal requirement.

Task T029 implements the fallback to Cochran-Armitage but omits the specific acceptance criterion from FR-008: 'report the EPV limitation'. The task description only mentions switching tests, failing to preserve the full verification step required by the spec.

Task T008 allows an automatic model fallback (Llama-8B to Qwen-1.8B) if memory limits are hit. This silently relaxes FR-002's requirement to execute on 'Llama-3-8B'. The spec must be amended to explicitly allow this model substitution as a valid execution path, or the task must be scoped to fail if the 8B model cannot load, to preserve the FR's constraint.
